title: cassia retusa var. typica
intro: Cassia retusa var. typica, commonly known as Philippine senna, is a plant species native to the Philippines, belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cassia retusa var. typica include its ability to treat diarrhea, dysentery, and other gastrointestinal issues due to its purgative and laxative properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, saponins, and other alkaloids.
